name: Ndebele beaded bracelet
about: This is a handmade beadwork piece in the style of South Africa's Ndebele craft tradition. It is sold at Rosebank's craft market, a good place to find local work.
tip: Check whether the maker is named and whether the beadwork is handmade.

name: Shweshwe fabric
where: D.I. Dadabhay fabric shops or Three Cats outlets
about: Shweshwe is a printed cotton fabric with traditional patterns, known across South Africa. Johannesburg's fabric shops are a common place to buy it.
tip: Check the fabric at Three Cats.
